acceptanceCriteria: A preregistration amendment adds mention-anchored orientation tasks with frozen expected evidence before any run.
A sealed run scores them and records the outcome, including any failure, in docs/BUILD-LOG.md.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from V1-0192. V1-0192 adds path:line, path#symbol and commit mentions to the native prompt compiler (LCP-V0-013). Its acceptance criterion naming the frozen daily-loop evaluation could not be met inside that change: the daily-loop orientation job scores `corvint context --task`, not the prompt compiler, and its corpus is preregistered for V1-0012, so adding mention-anchored tasks is a preregistration amendment. This ticket records that amendment and a sealed run that scores prompt-mention orientation.
title: Amend the daily-loop preregistration with prompt-mention orientation tasks
